grounding.excerpt: The permittee is required to submit a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water
shall become effective on January 1, 2022. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, December 31, 2026.

rationale: The selected permit clause positively requires submission of a detailed plan to test for Delta-BHC at the source water. That operative language establishes a source-water intake study/planning obligation, not compliance with a numeric effluent concentration or routine DMR discharge-limit reporting. The cover-page term places this obligation within the Federal FY2025 window. Because the grounded obligation is a plan-to-test at source water rather than a numeric discharge limit, DMR absence of Delta-BHC is not, by itself, a discharge-limit exceedance.
